title: 第3章 苍澜学院第4章 测试道骨
content_zh:
“兄台，一个人？”
一道突兀的声音响起。
叶祈安循声看去，一锦衣黄袍少年举止优雅的端坐着，身上散发着若隐若现的元气波动。
看来也是个修炼之人。
闻言，叶祈安面无表情回应。
“嗯。”
那黄袍少年爽朗一笑，开口说道：“我看兄台气质非凡，就想着与你交个朋友。”
“不妨拼个桌如何?”
叶祈安听后环顾了一周，基本都已落座了，这少年看着并非难缠之人，拼一下也无妨。
“可以。”
“兄台贵姓？”
“叶平安。”眉毛微挑，缓缓说道。
“好名字，鄙人姓苏，单名一个也！”
那黄袍少年听后眉头皱起，自顾自的开口说道。
“叶平安？”
“怎地这名字跟天风国第一剑道天才的名字如此相似？”
随后他又摇摇头自言自语：“不不，怎么可能跟我的偶像是同一人？”
“哦？那这叶祈安是何许人也？值得苏兄如此推崇？”
提起叶祈安时，苏也神色露出崇拜之情。
话痨的毛病又开始犯了。

“叶祈安，天风国年轻一辈最妖孽的天才，十岁修剑，仅仅用八年的时间修炼至地元境巅峰！”
对此，叶祈安古井无波的眼神出现了一丝波动。
叶祈安已经死了，从被逐出天门剑宗的时候就已经死了，现在活着的是叶平安。
苏也见他并没有说话，还以为是被自己的言语给震撼到。
“看兄台这气质想必也是去苍澜学院进行新生考核的吧？”
“我跟你说......”
简单填饱了肚子，叶祈安就告别回到了房间中。
苏也举起酒杯一饮而尽，看着叶祈安离去的背影呢喃自语：“真是个孤僻冷漠的家伙。”
回到房间中先是简单的洗漱一遍，随后盘腿坐下。
从苏也的对话中也是了解到了一些有用的信息。
首先没想到这话痨公子竟然还是燕归城三大家族之一苏家的人，看他的装扮气质来看在其家族中的地位应该不低。
其次，自己在剑冢中重铸经脉时间过去了一年时间！
content_en:
"Brother, alone?"
A sudden voice sounded.
Ye Qi'an followed the sound and saw a young man in brocade and yellow robes sitting elegantly, exuding faint fluctuations of vitality.
It seems that he is also a cultivator.
Hearing this, Ye Qi'an responded expressionlessly.
"Yeah."
The young man in yellow robe smiled heartily and said, "I see that my brother has extraordinary temperament, so I just want to make friends with you."
"How about sharing a table?"
After hearing this, Ye Qian looked around for a week and found that everyone was already seated. This young man didn't seem to be a difficult person, so it wouldn't hurt to give him a try.
"Okay."
"Brother, what's your surname?"
"Ye Pingan." He raised his eyebrows slightly and said slowly.
"What a good name. My surname is Su, and I don't have a single name!"
The young man in yellow robe frowned after hearing this and said to himself.
"Ye Pingan?"
"Why is this name so similar to the name of Tianfeng Kingdom's number one swordsman?"
Then he shook his head and said to himself: "No, no, how could it be possible that my idol is the same person?"
"Oh? Who is this Ye Qi'an? Is he worthy of Brother Su's respect?"
When he mentioned Ye Qian'an, Su Ye showed admiration.
The habit of talking a lot started to happen again.
"Ye Qian, the most evil genius of the younger generation in Tianfeng Kingdom, practiced swordsmanship at the age of ten, and only spent eight years practicing to reach the peak of the Earth Element Realm!"
In response, there was a slight fluctuation in Ye Qian Gujing Wubo's eyes.
Ye Qian'an is dead. He has been dead since he was expelled from Tianmen Sword Sect. The one who is alive now is Ye Ping'an.
Su Ye saw that he didn't speak, and thought he was shocked by his words.
"Looking at your temperament, Xiongtai must have gone to Canglan College for the freshman assessment, right?"
"I'm telling you..."
After simply filling his stomach, Ye Qian said goodbye and returned to the room.
Su Ye raised his glass and drank it down in one gulp, looking at Ye Qian's leaving back and murmuring to himself: "What a lonely and indifferent guy."
After returning to the room, I washed myself briefly and then sat down cross-legged.
I also learned some useful information from Su Ye's conversation.
First of all, I didn't expect that this talkative young master was actually from the Su family, one of the three major families in Yangui City. Judging from his appearance and temperament, his status in his family should be high.
Secondly, a year has passed since I recast the meridians in the Sword Tomb!
